title: Responsibility for Payment of Wages
summary: Every employer shall be responsible for the payment of all wages required to be paid under this Act to persons employed by him. In establishments and factories, the designated manager or supervisor is also held responsible.
verbatim_extract: Every employer shall be responsible for the payment to persons employed by him of all wages required to be paid under this Act...

title: Time of Payment of Wages & Final Settlement on Termination
summary: Wages must be paid before the expiry of the 7th or 10th day after the wage period ends. Crucially, where the employment of any person is terminated by or on behalf of the employer, the wages earned by him must be paid before the expiry of the second working day from the day on which his employment is terminated.
verbatim_extract: Where the employment of any person is terminated by or on behalf of the employer, the wages earned by him shall be paid before the expiry of the second working day from the day on which his employment is terminated...

title: Deductions which may be made from Wages
summary: The wages of an employed person must be paid without deductions of any kind except those specifically authorized by or under this Act (such as fines, absence from duty, statutory taxes, provident fund, or recovery of loans). Arbitrary penalties or retention of notice period pay without contractual justification is impermissible.
verbatim_extract: the wages of an employed person shall be paid to him without deductions of any kind except those authorised by or under this Act...

title: Claims Arising out of Deductions or Delay in Payment of Wages
summary: An employee whose wages have been delayed or improperly deducted can file an application before the appointed Authority (Labour Commissioner). The Authority can direct refund of the deducted amount or payment of delayed wages, together with compensation up to ten times the amount deducted, or reasonable compensation for delay.
verbatim_extract: the Authority may... direct the refund to the employed person of the amount deducted, or the payment of the delayed wages, together with the payment of such compensation as the Authority may think fit...

title: Dismissal of an Individual Workman Deemed an Industrial Dispute
summary: Where any employer discharges, dismisses, retrenches or terminates the services of an individual workman, any dispute or difference connected with or arising out of such dismissal shall be deemed to be an industrial dispute, permitting the individual to approach the Conciliation Officer without union sponsorship.
verbatim_extract: Where any employer discharges, dismisses, retrenches or otherwise terminates the services of an individual workman, any dispute or difference between that workman and his employer... shall be deemed to be an industrial dispute...

title: Conditions Precedent to Retrenchment of Workmen
summary: No workman who has been in continuous service for not less than one year shall be retrenched until given one month's notice in writing indicating reasons or paid wages in lieu of notice, and paid compensation equivalent to 15 days average pay for every completed year of service.
verbatim_extract: No workman employed in any industry who has been in continuous service for not less than one year... shall be retrenched by that employer until the workman has been given one month's notice in writing... or paid wages in lieu...

title: Agreement in Restraint of Trade Void
summary: Every agreement by which anyone is restrained from exercising a lawful profession, trade or business of any kind is to that extent void. In India, post-employment non-compete clauses restraining an employee from joining a competitor are generally void and unenforceable.
verbatim_extract: Every agreement by which any one is restrained from exercising a lawful profession, trade or business of any kind, is to that extent void.
